title: E2MoCase: A Dataset for Emotional, Event and Moral Observations in News Articles on High-impact Legal Cases

bias_targets.methodology: Manual categorization of source legal cases for religious bias, followed by automated LLM-based annotation of the associated news coverage paragraphs for emotional tone, moral framing (via Moral Foundation Theory), and event occurrences.
